messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — hotfix PR #5432 (ccr subsystem) is queued for the cutover tonight. We need 2x LGTM before the 23:00 UTC cutoff. Perf test is flaky right now; blocking on one regression. Can folks spare 10–15m to eyeball? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ajay: On it, can you paste the failing test logs or point me to the run?
sophia: I can do a quick review in ~12m, ping me when tests are re-run.
ryan: I saw the failure earlier — `test_cache_eviction::evict_on_pressure` times out intermittently. Looks related to the recent iterator change in PR. I pushed a small tweak to the branch (fix/evict-timeout) to increase the timeout and added a log.
maria: thanks @ryan — re-running CI now. command I ran locally: ```./dev/ci/run_single.sh pr-5432 --focus test_cache_eviction``` will post link when green.
deploy-bot: CI update: PR #5432 — linux-integration (rerun) started — https://ci.internal.redwood/5432/6789
olivia: taking a look at the diff now. main concern is surface-area of change to the eviction loop; looking for unexpected lock contention.
ajay: quick question — if CI stays flaky, are we comfortable cutting with a mitigated rollback plan? what's the rollback path?
maria: rollback plan: immediate revert of PR and hotpatch rollforward disabled, ops will pin previous model variant for 1h. ops runbook: `ops/rollbacks/ccr-hotfix.md` (short link: https://confluence/ccr/rollback). Prefer to avoid, so second LGTM needed.
ryan: CI passed: https://ci.internal.redwood/5432/6789 — all integration tests green (rerun).
sophia: LGTM — verified tests, skimmed change, didn't find locking regressions. Left a tiny comment about log verbosity (non-blocking). :white_check_mark:
olivia: LGTM as well. tested locally with a stress harness for ~5m, eviction behavior looks stable.
maria: Awesome — 2x LGTM achieved. I'll proceed to schedule the cutover at 22:45 UTC (slightly earlier than cutoff) to give time for smoke checks. Notifying oncall. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: PR #5432 -> canary @ 22:45 UTC. Watch: https://deploys.redwood/ccr/5432
ajay: thanks team — will monitor metrics and error budgets during the window. ping me if anything looks off.
maria: thanks all — will post a brief post-cutover status here. If anything needs rollback, escalate to #eng-oncall and @ajay. :handshake:
